name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '03' is the meaningful chapter id (chapters 01-30 per the FDFIELD/FDTXT chapter set and the chapter-end dispatch table @ 0x51DE9 slot 2 @ 0x51DF1), not an address residue. Descriptor 'end' correctly marks it as the chapter-end (post-clear) handler, paired with fd2_chapter_03_init @ 0x32E8C.
purpose: Chapter 3 (往塞拉村途中) end handler: persists the party, conditionally stages the recruit scene and recruits 劍士鐵諾 if the survivor unit is alive, then advances to the next chapter.
logic_summary: Unconditionally copies the three 7-byte chapter-3 end-scene placement tables (X/Y/facing @ 0x520BA/0x520C1/0x520C8) into three on-stack char-placement blocks. Calls fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template() to persist the party. Branches on fd2_check_char_is_dead(6): if survivor runtime char #6 is alive (==0), stages the scene via fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro (place chars 0..6, no extra char, camera origin (2,0)), shows recruit dialog page 7, and recruits char #2 (劍士鐵諾) via fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(2); if dead, shows the no-recruit dialog page 6 only. Finally increments data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id by 1. The placement tables are read before the branch (matching the binary) but consumed only on the alive/recruit path. Matches walkthrough: 加入: 劍士鐵諾若未死時加入.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects only (party persisted, scene/dialog staged, optional recruit, current chapter id advanced).

notes: No params: __cdecl void; the decompiler's in_stack_* are artifacts of the __CHK stack-probe builtin, not real arguments. Dispatch verified: dword @ 0x51DF1 = f2 30 02 00 = 0x000230f2 (this fn), next slot bc 31 02 00 = fd2_chapter_04_end; table base 0x51DE9 referenced from main @ 0x25E23. Recruit identity confirmed via fd2-knowledge chapter 3 walkthrough (劍士鐵諾 joins if not dead). Source comment and Ghidra plate both accurate and consistent with the binary -> left unchanged. Source for-loop copy of 7 bytes/table is functionally equivalent to the decompiler's unrolled reads of indices [0..6]; no logic discrepancy.
